execution_authorization.reason: Source freeze only; numerical execution requires a separate exact root-go token in SOURCE_PINS.json.

saved_result.role: previously accepted fixed 93-DOF elastic cohesive bridge; JSON-only input for this diagnostic

geometry.shape: straight finite crack sheet through centered cylinder

loading.sequence_meaning: ramp to full damage; partial-damage unload/reload; full-damage unload to zero and reload
loading.compression: not entered; negative opening is a hard failure

equilibrium_and_energy.bulk_unit_control_system: one 100x100 KKT solve from saved K_raw and C_phys; no body or boundary load; C_phys*q=0 and e82 dot q=1
equilibrium_and_energy.scaled_kkt: symmetric diagonal equilibration and normalized physical-gauge rows; recover physical q and lambda
equilibrium_and_energy.noncontrol_force_rule: all entries except index 82 must be numerical zero within the frozen force tolerance
equilibrium_and_energy.cohesive_work: independent exact piecewise-linear law path integral, checked against area-weighted primitive cumulative-work differences
equilibrium_and_energy.global_balance: control work increment equals change in bulk stored + cohesive stored + cohesive dissipated energy
equilibrium_and_energy.corner_at_zero: record the pinned primitive status and reasons; do not project or use its tangent in a solve

scope_exclusions: no autonomous crack growth or front advance
